question: Which of our strategic accounts are at risk because of late shipments, and what should the account teams do this week?

input.purpose: Check account tier values and counts in Salesforce (current records only)
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted, SUM(CASE WHEN _fivetran_active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_rows FROM salesforce.account GROUP BY tier_c ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check carrier shipment status values and freshness
input.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, MAX(updated_at) last_update, SUM(CASE WHEN _fivetran_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) del FROM carrier_pg.shipment GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check Zendesk ticket types, statuses and tags for shipping-related issues
input.sql: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) n FROM zendesk.ticket_tag WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50

input.purpose: Check SAP delivery header dates and carrier field freshness
input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, MIN(wadat) min_wadat, MAX(wadat) max_wadat, SUM(CASE WHEN try_strptime(wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_actual, SUM(CASE WHEN try_strptime(lfdat,'%Y%m%d') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_promised FROM sap_s4.likp WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted

input.purpose: Check Salesforce SAP customer number linkage to SAP customer master
input.sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.sap_customer_number_c, a.tier_c, a.region_c, a._fivetran_active, a.is_deleted, k.kunnr, k.name_1, k._fivetran_deleted FROM salesforce.account a LEFT JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 k ON k.kunnr = a.sap_customer_number_c WHERE a.tier_c='Strategic' ORDER BY a.name

input.purpose: Look at sample delivery rows to understand promised vs actual dates
input.sql: SELECT vbeln, kunnr, vstel, erdat, wadat, wadat_ist, lfdat, zz_carrier_id, _fivetran_synced FROM sap_s4.likp WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted ORDER BY vbeln DESC LIMIT 30

input.purpose: Check carrier event types and how shipments link to SAP delivery numbers
input.sql: SELECT e.event_type, COUNT(*) n, MIN(e.event_at) mn, MAX(e.event_at) mx, MAX(e._fivetran_synced) synced FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE NOT e._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY e.event_type ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check shipment table linkage to SAP deliveries and carrier codes
input.sql: SELECT s.carrier_code, s.status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(l.vbeln) matched_to_sap, COUNT(DISTINCT s.delivery_number) distinct_deliv FROM carrier_pg.shipment s LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Compare carrier delivered timestamp vs SAP promised date and SAP actual goods issue, by month
input.sql:
WITH d AS (
 SELECT s.delivery_number, l.kunnr, l.lfdat, l.wadat_ist, l.wadat,
   CAST(e.event_at AS DATE) AS deliv_date,
   try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE AS promised,
   try_strptime(l.wadat_ist,'%Y%m%d')::DATE AS gi_actual
 FROM carrier_pg.shipment s
 JOIN carrier_pg.shipment_event e ON e.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted
 JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted
 WHERE s.status='delivered' AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted)
SELECT strftime(promised,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) n,
 ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN deliv_date <= promised THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) pct_ontime_carrier,
 ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN gi_actual <= promised THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) pct_ontime_gi,
 SUM(CASE WHEN gi_actual IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_gi
FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 18

input.purpose: Per strategic account: on-time rate and late delivery count over last 90 days (promised date window), plus open past-due shipments
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT name, sap_customer_number_c kunnr, region_c FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND NOT is_deleted AND sap_customer_number_c IS NOT NULL),
dl AS (
 SELECT l.kunnr, l.vbeln, l.zz_carrier_id, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE promised, s.status,
   (SELECT MIN(CAST(e.event_at AS DATE)) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted) deliv
 FROM sap_s4.likp l
 LEFT JOIN carrier_pg.shipment s ON s.delivery_number = l.vbeln AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted
 WHERE NOT l._fivetran_deleted)
SELECT st.name, st.region_c,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.deliv IS NOT NULL AND d.promised BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-08' AND DATE '2026-11-06') delivered_90d,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.deliv > d.promised AND d.promised BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-08' AND DATE '2026-11-06') late_90d,
 ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.deliv <= d.promised AND d.promised BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-08' AND DATE '2026-11-06') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.deliv IS NOT NULL AND d.promised BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-08' AND DATE '2026-11-06'),0),1) ontime_pct_90d,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status IN ('label_created','picked_up','in_transit') AND d.promised < DATE '2026-11-06') open_past_promise
FROM strat st LEFT JOIN dl d ON d.kunnr = st.kunnr
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY ontime_pct_90d ASC NULLS LAST

input.purpose: Check how Zendesk organizations map to Salesforce accounts
input.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.external_id, COUNT(t.id) tickets FROM zendesk.organization o LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket t ON t.organization_id=o.id AND NOT t._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT o._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY tickets DESC LIMIT 60

input.purpose: Check late-delivery rate by carrier and month to see if the October drop is concentrated
input.sql:
WITH d AS (
 SELECT l.zz_carrier_id carrier, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE promised, (SELECT MIN(CAST(e.event_at AS DATE)) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted) deliv
 FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE s.status='delivered' AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted)
SELECT carrier, strftime(promised,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN deliv<=promised THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) ontime
FROM d WHERE promised >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND deliv IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

input.purpose: Late-delivery rate by carrier (from carrier system) and month
input.sql:
WITH d AS (
 SELECT s.carrier_code carrier, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::DATE promised, (SELECT MIN(CAST(e.event_at AS DATE)) FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' AND NOT e._fivetran_deleted) deliv
 FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted WHERE s.status='delivered' AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted)
SELECT carrier, strftime(promised,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN deliv<=promised THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) ontime
FROM d WHERE promised >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND deliv IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

input.purpose: Count open shipping/late tickets per strategic account in Zendesk, with ticket subjects and tags
input.sql:
SELECT a.name, t.id, t.created_at::DATE created, t.status, t.priority, t.type, t.subject, STRING_AGG(tg.tag, ',') tags
FROM zendesk.ticket t
JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.id=t.organization_id
JOIN salesforce.account a ON a.id=o.external_id AND a.tier_c='Strategic'
LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tg ON tg.ticket_id=t.id AND NOT tg._fivetran_deleted
WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') 
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY a.name, t.created_at

answer.answer_summary: Eleven strategic accounts are below 85% on-time delivery over the last 90 days (promised dates 8 Aug to 6 Nov 2026). The most urgent are Tamwick Mining (61.5%), Quenmere Paper Mills (68.4%), Tamford Food Processing (69.0%) and Galbury Steelworks (73.9%), and each has open shipping tickets. I could not pull renewal close dates before the query budget ran out, so those need checking in Salesforce before the account teams call.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: Lowest on-time rate of the strategic accounts (10 of 26 delivered orders late). Open tickets: bearings delay on line 1227 (high, open), order 0010002384 arrived late (new), late delivery on order 0010007141 (high, pending).
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Escalate this week: get a confirmed delivery date for each open order from logistics, name an owner, and call the customer's plant contact. Pull the renewal date from Salesforce.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 19 orders late. Open tickets: 'Where is my order 0010001338?' (open), late delivery on order 0010001475 (on hold), tracking not updating for TRK2708517431 (urgent, pending). Salesforce shows this account as inactive (_fivetran_active = false).
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Confirm the account's status in Salesforce first, since it is flagged inactive. If it is still a strategic account, trace the two missing orders and fix the tracking gap, then call the customer.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 9 of 29 orders late. Open tickets: order 0010005071 not received yet (open), order 0010005601 arrived late (open).
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Get proof of delivery or a new ETA for both open orders this week, and review the North America carrier lanes this account uses.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 23 orders late. Open shipping tickets: order 0010006602 still missing (urgent, open), bearings delay on line 8396 (urgent, pending), order 0010003309 not received (open), order 0010000850 arrived late (new). A credit note request is also open.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Highest open-ticket load of the group. Assign one account owner, resolve the missing-order cases first, and give the customer a written recovery plan.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 8 of 31 orders late. Open: order 0010004676 arrived late (open). A seal-kit product question is also open, but it is not a shipping issue.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Close the open late-order case with a root cause and confirm on-time delivery for the next two orders.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 7 of 30 orders late. Open: order 0010005979 'has it left your warehouse?' (open), shipment TRK1211859787 delayed again (open).
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Check warehouse release status for order 0010005979 and send the customer a firm delivery date for TRK1211859787.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 26 orders late. Open: order 0010002553 arrived late (pending), late delivery on order 0010006784 (pending), order 0010007869 arrived late (urgent, open). Salesforce has a duplicate record, 'Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH', with no SAP customer number.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Fix the duplicate Salesforce record so the account is reported once. Then review the three late orders with the customer's EMEA contact.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 27 orders late. Open: tracking not updating for TRK8633730121 (open, low priority).
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Fix the tracking feed for this shipment and confirm its delivery status with the customer.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 4 of 19 orders late. Open: delivery for order 0010003651 still missing (on hold, high priority). Also a warranty claim (urgent) and a billing question.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Release the held order for order 0010003651 or give the customer an ETA, and bundle the warranty and billing items into one account review.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 5 of 27 orders late in the 90-day window. No open shipping tickets found.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Watch list only. Review the five late orders for a repeat pattern by carrier or lane, and flag the account if on-time falls below 85% next month.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 3 of 19 orders late, on the threshold. Open shipping tickets: has order 0010008811 left the warehouse? (open), delay on bearings for line 8407 (on hold), order 0003556 arrived late (pending). A high-priority bearing running hot after install (product issue) is also open.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: The on-time rate is near the threshold but three shipping tickets are open. Clear the shipping cases this week and handle the bearing quality issue with product engineering.

metrics_used.name: On-time delivery rate (account level)
metrics_used.definition: Share of delivered shipments whose first carrier 'delivered' event date is on or before the SAP promised date (likp.lfdat). Measured over deliveries with promised dates from 8 Aug 2026 to 6 Nov 2026 (last 90 days). Late = delivered after the promised date.

metrics_used.name: Late deliveries
metrics_used.definition: Count of delivered shipments in the 90-day window whose carrier delivered date is after the SAP promised date.

metrics_used.name: Open shipping tickets
metrics_used.definition: Zendesk tickets with status new, open, pending or hold, linked to the strategic account through organization external_id, whose subject describes a late, missing, not-received, or untracked delivery. Product, warranty and billing tickets are excluded.

metrics_used.name: Strategic account
metrics_used.definition: Salesforce account with tier_c = 'Strategic' and is_deleted = false (27 records, 26 active).

lineage: carrier_pg.shipment + carrier_pg.shipment_event (delivered event) -> sap_s4.likp (lfdat promised date, customer kunnr) -> on-time rate by account -> at-risk accounts
zendesk.ticket + zendesk.organization (external_id = salesforce.account.id) + zendesk.ticket_tag -> open shipping tickets

freshness.last_synced: not checked (last ticket update used for context only)

assumptions: 'Strategic' means salesforce.account tier_c = 'Strategic' with is_deleted = false (27 records; 26 are active).

Late means the carrier's first 'delivered' event falls after the SAP promised date (likp.lfdat). I did not use SAP goods-issue date (wadat_ist), because it is about 98% on time and measures the warehouse, not the carrier.
The window is the last 90 days by promised date (8 Aug to 6 Nov 2026). Shipments with no delivered event are excluded from the rate.
The 85% threshold for 'at risk' is my own choice, not a Torvane standard. The company-wide rate runs about 88 to 94% by month.
Open shipping tickets are counted by reading the subjects of tickets with status new, open, pending or hold. Tags were not used, because many late-delivery tickets have no tag.
Halbrook Fluid Systems and 'Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH' are treated as one account, using the SAP-linked record for the metrics.
caveats: Renewal close dates were not pulled (I did not query salesforce.opportunity before the query budget ran out). All renewal_close_date fields are null and must be checked before account teams act on timing.
Quenmere Paper Mills is flagged inactive in Salesforce (_fivetran_active = false) but still tagged Strategic. Confirm its status before outreach.
Fivetran sync timestamps read 11 Nov 2026, five days after the as-of date. Event data runs to 6 Nov, so I treated the data as current, but the sync clock should be checked.
The 2026-11 month is partial (104 deliveries), so I did not use it for trend claims.

The October dip (about 88% company-wide) was concentrated in carrier VELX (81.6%) and NRTH (89.5%). I did not break down per-account results by carrier, so carrier root cause for each account is unverified.
Ticket classification is based on subject text and may miss or misclassify some tickets. Counts are a reasonable read, not an audited count.
Late counts and rates are for the 90-day window only. Accounts with few orders (for example Vornwick, 19) can move a lot with one shipment.

explanation.title: Read every history row of the account tier
explanation.detail: salesforce.account keeps one row per version of each account (history mode). Without filtering to _fivetran_active, accounts that changed tier appear twice, and Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH still looks Strategic.
